system.description: You expel your own blood through your skin into a subject to cleanse his mind and soul of outside supernatural influence, such as Dominate commands, Dementation-induced derangements, or Presence-imparted imperatives. You touch the subject's forehead, and both of you spend at least five minutes in deep concentration. Spend a number of Blood Traits equal to the subject's permanent Mental Traits. The subject then makes a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty 7 Traits) for each external supernatural influence he wishes to purge; success nullifies that effect. Purification cannot remove influences transmitted by blood (a blood bond, clan or bloodline dispositions), nor mundane persuasion, hypnosis, or genuine emotion such as love or hate. It can remove mind-altering blood magic effects, but either you or the beneficiary must know a level of blood magic equal to or greater than that used to create the effect. You cannot use this power on yourself.
system.bloodCost: Equal to subject's permanent Mental Traits
